raw_findings.body: I18n::Backend::Fallbacks looks up the fallback locales in a backend where their yml files were never loaded (the freedom patch's `translate` only calls `load_locale(config.locale)`), so the lookup returns a MissingTranslation instead of the site-locale/English string, producing "translation missing" text in emails and background-generated content.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Silent wrong output: translations resolve to MissingTranslation in non-request execution paths.
raw_findings.impact: I18n::Backend::Fallbacks looks up the fallback locales in a backend where their yml files were never loaded (the freedom patch's `translate` only calls `load_locale(config.locale)`), so the lookup returns a MissingTranslation instead of the site-locale/English string, producing "translation missing" text in emails and background-generated content.
raw_findings.root_cause: Fallback lookups were enabled globally, but the on-demand locale loader is only primed for the current locale in one controller filter rather than for the whole fallback chain wherever translation occurs.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Move the fallback preloading into the translation path itself, e.g. in `I18n.translate` of lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb call `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` (or iterate `I18n.fallbacks[config.locale]` calling `ensure_loaded!`) instead of relying solely on the controller filter.
raw_findings.title: Fallback locales are only preloaded in web requests, not in jobs/mailers
raw_findings.trigger: Any translation performed outside ApplicationController#set_locale, e.g. Sidekiq (`app/jobs/base.rb:151` sets `I18n.locale = SiteSetting.default_locale`) or `I18n.with_locale(user.effective_locale)` in `app/services/post_alerter.rb:138`, when the requested key is missing from that locale's yml.

raw_findings.body: The process-wide cache in lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb keys entries only on `"#{key}#{config.locale}#{config.backend.object_id}"`, so a fallback result resolved through one site's default locale is served to the other site (French text on the English site), and changing `default_locale` keeps serving stale fallback text until restart.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Cached translations become incorrect/stale and leak across tenants.
raw_findings.impact: The process-wide cache in lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb keys entries only on `"#{key}#{config.locale}#{config.backend.object_id}"`, so a fallback result resolved through one site's default locale is served to the other site (French text on the English site), and changing `default_locale` keeps serving stale fallback text until restart.
raw_findings.root_cause: Fallback resolution was made dependent on per-site mutable state (`SiteSetting.default_locale`) while the memoized translation cache remains keyed only by key+locale+backend.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Include the effective fallback chain (e.g. `SiteSetting.default_locale`) in the cache key used by `I18n.translate` in translate_accelerator.rb, or clear the LRU cache when the `default_locale` site setting changes.
raw_findings.title: Translation LRU cache key omits default_locale although fallback chain depends on it
raw_findings.trigger: A multisite process (RailsMultisite) where site A has `default_locale = fr` and site B has `default_locale = en`, both serving users with `I18n.locale = :de`; or a single site where an admin changes `default_locale` after some translations have been cached.

raw_findings.body: `nil.to_sym` raises NoMethodError inside `FallbackLocaleList#[]`, which is invoked from `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks#translate` and from `ensure_loaded!` in the `set_locale` before_filter, so every request raises a 500 rather than falling back to `:en` as the trailing `.compact` intends.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Unhandled NoMethodError on every translation when default_locale is nil.
raw_findings.impact: `nil.to_sym` raises NoMethodError inside `FallbackLocaleList#[]`, which is invoked from `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks#translate` and from `ensure_loaded!` in the `set_locale` before_filter, so every request raises a 500 rather than falling back to `:en` as the trailing `.compact` intends.
raw_findings.root_cause: The nil-removal (`compact`) is applied after the nil-dereferencing conversion (`to_sym`), making the guard dead code.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Compute the fallback list defensively, e.g. `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale, :en].compact.map(&:to_sym).uniq`, so a nil default locale is dropped before `to_sym`.
raw_findings.title: `compact` placed after `to_sym` cannot guard a nil default_locale
raw_findings.trigger: `SiteSetting.default_locale` returning nil (the codebase already defends against this in lib/tasks/db.rake with `(SiteSetting.default_locale || :en) rescue :en`), then any translation lookup that consults the fallback list.

raw_findings.body: Already-recorded loaded locales are discarded, so `load_locale` re-enters its `@loaded_locales.empty?` branch and re-loads every `.rb` translation file and yml files under the mutex, adding avoidable request latency and duplicated backend loads.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Race window silently resets loaded-locale bookkeeping, causing redundant translation loading.
raw_findings.impact: Already-recorded loaded locales are discarded, so `load_locale` re-enters its `@loaded_locales.empty?` branch and re-loads every `.rb` translation file and yml files under the mutex, adding avoidable request latency and duplicated backend loads.
raw_findings.root_cause: New public entry point mutates the shared `@loaded_locales` state without holding the mutex that all other mutations use.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Initialize `@loaded_locales = []` where `LOAD_MUTEX` is defined (or perform the `||=` inside `LOAD_MUTEX.synchronize`) instead of lazily assigning it in `ensure_loaded!`.
raw_findings.title: Lazy init of @loaded_locales in ensure_loaded! runs outside LOAD_MUTEX
raw_findings.trigger: Two request threads calling `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` concurrently right after boot/`reload!`: both read `@loaded_locales` as nil, one enters `load_locale` (mutex) and appends a locale, then the second thread's `||=` assignment replaces the array.

raw_findings.body: Regressions in the fallback order (user locale -> site default_locale -> :en) or in on-demand loading of fallback locales ship undetected, since nothing asserts that a key missing in a user locale resolves through the site locale and that the fallback yml files get loaded.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Review/CI cannot detect breakage of the newly introduced fallback behavior.
raw_findings.impact: Regressions in the fallback order (user locale -> site default_locale -> :en) or in on-demand loading of fallback locales ship undetected, since nothing asserts that a key missing in a user locale resolves through the site locale and that the fallback yml files get loaded.
raw_findings.root_cause: New fallback ordering and lazy-loading logic was introduced without accompanying test coverage.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Add a spec (e.g. spec/components/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator_spec.rb) that sets `SiteSetting.default_locale`, sets `I18n.locale` to another locale, and asserts both the array returned by `I18n.fallbacks[locale]` and that a key present only in the fallback locale resolves after `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!`.
raw_findings.title: No spec covers the new server-side fallback chain or ensure_loaded!
raw_findings.trigger: Running the suite after this patch: `grep fallback spec/` matches only spec/components/discourse_stylesheets_spec.rb, and there is no spec exercising `FallbackLocaleList#[]`, `FallbackLocaleList#ensure_loaded!`, or `I18n.ensure_loaded!`.

raw_findings.body: Fallback support silently applies to a class that may not be the active backend, giving inconsistent behavior between pluralization and fallbacks and making the initializer's effect depend on backend instantiation order.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Maintainability/consistency defect that can make fallbacks inactive on a swapped backend.
raw_findings.impact: Fallback support silently applies to a class that may not be the active backend, giving inconsistent behavior between pluralization and fallbacks and making the initializer's effect depend on backend instantiation order.
raw_findings.root_cause: The include target is derived from a runtime instance (`I18n.backend.class`) rather than the explicit backend class used elsewhere in the same file.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Mirror line 5 and use `I18n::Backend::Simple.send(:include, I18n::Backend::Fallbacks)` so both modules target the same, explicitly named backend class without eagerly instantiating `I18n.backend`.
raw_findings.title: Fallbacks included via I18n.backend.class instead of I18n::Backend::Simple
raw_findings.trigger: Boot of the app: this line forces instantiation of the default backend; if any later code or plugin assigns a new `I18n.backend` (or a Chain backend is already installed), the Fallbacks module is mixed into a different class than the Pluralization module on line 5.

validated_findings.verifier_reason: The claim that `nil.to_sym` will crash is incorrect. `SiteSetting.default_locale` returns a string from the site settings system with a default value - it's not expected to return nil in normal operation. The evidence shows `lib/tasks/db.rake` uses `rescue :en` as defensive coding for rake tasks, not because nil is a normal return value. The `.compact` handles the theoretical nil case after conversion, but the premise that nil is a realistic trigger is ungrounded.

validated_findings.body: Already-recorded loaded locales are discarded, so `load_locale` re-enters its `@loaded_locales.empty?` branch and re-loads every `.rb` translation file and yml files under the mutex, adding avoidable request latency and duplicated backend loads.
validated_findings.failure_mode: Race window silently resets loaded-locale bookkeeping, causing redundant translation loading.
validated_findings.impact: Already-recorded loaded locales are discarded, so `load_locale` re-enters its `@loaded_locales.empty?` branch and re-loads every `.rb` translation file and yml files under the mutex, adding avoidable request latency and duplicated backend loads.
validated_findings.root_cause: New public entry point mutates the shared `@loaded_locales` state without holding the mutex that all other mutations use.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Initialize `@loaded_locales = []` where `LOAD_MUTEX` is defined (or perform the `||=` inside `LOAD_MUTEX.synchronize`) instead of lazily assigning it in `ensure_loaded!`.
validated_findings.title: Lazy init of @loaded_locales in ensure_loaded! runs outside LOAD_MUTEX
validated_findings.trigger: Two request threads calling `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` concurrently right after boot/`reload!`: both read `@loaded_locales` as nil, one enters `load_locale` (mutex) and appends a locale, then the second thread's `||=` assignment replaces the array.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: The race condition claim is technically possible but the impact is overstated. The `@loaded_locales ||= []` in `ensure_loaded!` could theoretically race, but `load_locale` is protected by `LOAD_MUTEX` and checks `@loaded_locales.include?(locale)` inside the mutex. Even if the array is reset, the mutex-protected `load_locale` will correctly reload. The worst case is redundant loading, not corruption, and the trigger requires very specific timing at boot.

validated_findings.body: Regressions in the fallback order (user locale -> site default_locale -> :en) or in on-demand loading of fallback locales ship undetected, since nothing asserts that a key missing in a user locale resolves through the site locale and that the fallback yml files get loaded.
validated_findings.failure_mode: Review/CI cannot detect breakage of the newly introduced fallback behavior.
validated_findings.impact: Regressions in the fallback order (user locale -> site default_locale -> :en) or in on-demand loading of fallback locales ship undetected, since nothing asserts that a key missing in a user locale resolves through the site locale and that the fallback yml files get loaded.
validated_findings.root_cause: New fallback ordering and lazy-loading logic was introduced without accompanying test coverage.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Add a spec (e.g. spec/components/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator_spec.rb) that sets `SiteSetting.default_locale`, sets `I18n.locale` to another locale, and asserts both the array returned by `I18n.fallbacks[locale]` and that a key present only in the fallback locale resolves after `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!`.
validated_findings.title: No spec covers the new server-side fallback chain or ensure_loaded!
validated_findings.trigger: Running the suite after this patch: `grep fallback spec/` matches only spec/components/discourse_stylesheets_spec.rb, and there is no spec exercising `FallbackLocaleList#[]`, `FallbackLocaleList#ensure_loaded!`, or `I18n.ensure_loaded!`.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: This is a test coverage suggestion, not a bug finding. The absence of tests is a quality observation but not a defect in the code itself. The patch introduces new functionality that works as designed; whether it has test coverage is a process/quality concern, not a bug category.

validated_findings.body: Fallback support silently applies to a class that may not be the active backend, giving inconsistent behavior between pluralization and fallbacks and making the initializer's effect depend on backend instantiation order.
validated_findings.failure_mode: Maintainability/consistency defect that can make fallbacks inactive on a swapped backend.
validated_findings.impact: Fallback support silently applies to a class that may not be the active backend, giving inconsistent behavior between pluralization and fallbacks and making the initializer's effect depend on backend instantiation order.
validated_findings.root_cause: The include target is derived from a runtime instance (`I18n.backend.class`) rather than the explicit backend class used elsewhere in the same file.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Mirror line 5 and use `I18n::Backend::Simple.send(:include, I18n::Backend::Fallbacks)` so both modules target the same, explicitly named backend class without eagerly instantiating `I18n.backend`.
validated_findings.title: Fallbacks included via I18n.backend.class instead of I18n::Backend::Simple
validated_findings.trigger: Boot of the app: this line forces instantiation of the default backend; if any later code or plugin assigns a new `I18n.backend` (or a Chain backend is already installed), the Fallbacks module is mixed into a different class than the Pluralization module on line 5.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: This is a style/maintainability observation, not a functional bug. Line 9 uses `I18n.backend.class` while line 5 uses `I18n::Backend::Simple` directly. Both target the same class in practice since `I18n.backend` returns a Simple instance by default. The claim about backend swapping is speculative - no evidence shows plugins or code actually swap backends. This is at most an inconsistency, not a defect with observable impact.
